summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC. filed a Form 6-K reporting unaudited consolidated revenue for April 2026. Revenue was NT$2,460.5 million (US$77.8 million), down 1.6% month-over-month but up 32.2% year-over-year, driven by AI-related demand. The filing is a routine monthly revenue update containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant is the issuer filing routine operational results. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics disclosed. This is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation.
